annotationRationale: The decisive step uses the quadratic root sum and product to obtain a constant reciprocal sum. The discriminant verifies the real-root count, and arithmetic means and reciprocals complete the harmonic-mean calculation.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution, applying Vieta’s formulas to each quadratic and verifying that all 4050 roots are real, nonzero, and distinct.

review.mathCheck: Each quadratic has two real, nonzero roots, and different factors share none. Vieta gives reciprocal sum \((4/k)/(-3/k)=-4/3\) per pair. Thus the reciprocal mean is \(-2/3\), and the harmonic mean is \(-3/2\), choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of the first MAA Problem 18 solution on attached page 15, including its discriminant, distinctness, and pairwise Vieta arguments.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation is complete and appropriate for AMC 10. The statement, choices, and key agree; no figure is required.
